value: Short giantess simulator with illustrations by Terada Ochiko. Main character is fully voice acted.
The princess of the Lunafort Empire, Sakuya, has been sent to invade a planet to obtain some rare minerals. The first step being to subdue the population by destroying their cities.
Nekochigura (ICECAT) [DEV], Terada Ochiko [ILL], Aonagi Ibane [COV], Alicemagic [TR], Nashino Marimo [VA]
